question: Find Head and Neck trials with median follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, pubmed ID, and follow-up durations (overall, treatment arm, control arm) for clinical trials related to Head and Neck cancer.
gemini.assumptions: The question implies that the follow-up duration should be shown regardless of whether or not it is reported in months or any units. The query shows results for 'Head and Neck' cancer type in the "cancer_type" column. Follow-up duration is not filtered, all available values are returned.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Head and Neck%'",
  "answer": "This query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, pubmed ID, and follow-up durations (overall, treatment arm, control arm) for clinical trials related to Head and Neck cancer.",
  "assumptions": "The question implies that the follow-up duration should be shown regardless of whether or not it is reported in months or any units. The query shows results for 'Head and Neck' cancer type in the \"cancer_type\" column. Follow-up duration is not filtered, all available values are returned."
}
```
